description_en: Adds an elastic IP address (EIP) to a specified shared bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用AddGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp接口添加EIP到指定的带宽共享实例中
name: AddGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. 

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽型实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: global_acceleration_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the EIP. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36018.html operation to query the EIP ID. 

Make sure that the billing method of the EIP is pay-as-you-go and that the EIP and the shared bandwidth instance are in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
EIP实例的ID。 您可以通过调用DescribeEipAddresses (https://api.aliyun.com/document/Vpc/2016-04-28/DescribeEipAddresses)接口查询EIP实例的ID。 

确保EIP的计费类型为后付费，且EIP的地域和共享型实例相同。
parameters.name: ip_instance_id
